commit.message:
8376286: VM asserts with Possible safepoint reached by thread that does not allow it when running with -XX:+ExitOnFullCodeCache

Replace the manual before_exit() + exit_globals() + vm_direct_exit()
sequence with vm_exit() which correctly transitions the compiler
thread state to _thread_in_vm before initiating shutdown, allowing
it to safely acquire locks that may reach a safepoint.
